capability_boundary.next_step: offline controller/input factorial groundwork; no expanded parameter search
capability_boundary.trajectory_source: generic plant observer; no independent desired/lane path supplied

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Factor-only is not sufficient; friction-only still has 17.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Keep factor delta while altering only friction: observed 17 versus 37 failures.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Factor-only has 39 failures; both deltas removed eliminates MID failures.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Factor-only also changes failures; nonlinear interaction prevents additive allocation.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Remove friction correction with factor fixed: observed 39 versus 37 failures.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Friction-only reduces failures to 17; onset at frame41 has zero PID error/P/I and different feedforward.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Piecewise linear schedules and float32 readback are continuous within quantization, not a large breakpoint jump.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Compare identical inputs through frame200: v1/v2 samples exactly equal.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: 17.5 m/s lies in the changed 15..20 interpolation interval; sweep first v2-v1 torque difference frame201 at 15.05 m/s.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: A different global schedule has not been tested; conclusion is restricted to this frozen family.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Attenuating knot20 changes interpolation before20; v1 preservation holds only through15, not whole MID bucket.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: No clamping or lag from a slew filter can explain this run.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Inspect candidate prepare_schedule and unchanged physical delay owner.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: No slew mechanism is implemented; only a reject-on-rate bound.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: History hashes are exactly equal in all four arms; history configuration is not a changed cause.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Compare all history hashes, raw jerk and filtered jerk: exact equality.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Same desired history but feedback paths diverge and carry state across speed buckets.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Lookahead index and filtered jerk are exactly equal; no direct changed contribution.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Compare lookahead indexes and filtered jerk across all samples.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Fixed lookahead participates in stock feedforward.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: No delay ablation here; mismatch is not identified as differential v2 cause.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: A separately prefrozen prediction-delay experiment would be required; not performed.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Stock input history index16 differs from plant physical2-frame delay; this is common descriptive alignment context.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Existing stress uses constant high speed and does not falsify MID/sweep effects.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Matched MID/sweep delay perturbations would be a new explanatory policy; not performed.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Applied requested divergence follows the fixed two-frame plant delay; stress delay1/3 showed equal high-speed v2/baseline outputs.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Zero of37 failures are saturation-occupancy metrics; saturation alone does not explain entry onset.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Compare unclipped PID sum, limits and integral before/after clipping.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: PID clipping is observed and factor changes accel-space limits; final same torque can coexist with different feedback and integral.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: No integral reset ablation performed; P/feedback differences are larger at frame333.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: A separately frozen state intervention would be required to isolate I; not performed.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Sweep frame300 has baseline factor/friction but different PID I and feedback; differences persist after20.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Zero of37 failures are event-count metrics; both failing desired inputs are nonnegative.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Inspect original event counts and signed command differences; no forced sign-reversal explanation.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Reversal events occur in generic plant responses and are retained in each violation context.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Desired input/history are identical between arms; it cannot explain differential output as a path-quality finding.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Same input/different controller experiment is already executed.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Identical prescribed desired curvature excites entry/apex/exit; sweep changes v squared targets.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: Controlled schedule changes reproducibly change response; absence of real calibration does not erase observed diagnostic violations.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Independent calibrated plant/data would be needed for external validity; unavailable.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Nominal plant has high oscillation/clipping even in baseline; family conclusions are plant-conditional.

root_cause_assessments.contradicting_evidence: No unique additive causal percentage or real lane-quality attribution is established.
root_cause_assessments.falsification_test: Use a different offline architecture with a separately frozen experiment; do not expand this grid.
root_cause_assessments.supporting_evidence: Factor/friction counterfactuals account for where differing outputs originate.
